evidence: Record the deployment selection, start/completion times and display sequence; capture a stalled or failed update.

evidence: Save the installed version and a Home photo after the upgrade.

If interrupted before the original configuration was saved, restore only the recorded UI/USB state and report the missing baseline.

Send PUT http://airgradient_<serial>.local/api/v1/config with No Auth and Content-Type: application/json. Read back with GET at the same URL every five seconds for up to 20 seconds to confirm restoration.

Confirm each through GET at the same URL within 20 seconds.

Restore the recorded original firmware deployment assignment after device settings are restored. Record the installed version separately; changing the assignment alone does not restore the source image. Coordinate any subsequent firmware change with the next release case.
